en.content: Which one of the following statements is not true about enzymes?

options.content: Enzymes are non-specific for a reaction and substrate.
Almost all enzymes are proteins.
Enzymes work as catalysts by lowering the activation energy of a biochemical reaction.
The action of enzymes is temperature and pH specific.

en.explanation: Enzymes are mostly proteins. They function as catalysts in biochemical reactions by lowering the energy of activation. They are highly specific w.r.t. temperature and pH in their action.
